manifest.name: Integration Studio
manifest.description: HTTP connections, server secrets, reusable Library stages and autonomous server workflows.
manifest.author: AgentSys examples

library.name: Integration: Read Configuration
library.code: const records = await agentsys('GET', 'collections/integration-connections/records'); const config = records.records[0]?.data; if (!config) throw Error('Create a connection first'); node.output.value = config;

library.name: Integration: HTTP Request
library.code: const config = node.input.value; if (!config) throw Error('Connect configuration'); let url = config.endpoint; const parameters = Object.entries(config.parameters || {}).map(([k,v]) => encodeURIComponent(k) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(v)).join('&'); if (parameters) url += (url.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + parameters; const headers = config.auth === 'bearer' ? {Authorization: 'Bearer {{secret:' + config.secretName + '}}'} : {}; const answer = await agentsys('POST', 'net', {url, headers, timeout: 5000}); if (answer.status < 200 || answer.status >= 300) throw Error('HTTP ' + answer.status); node.output.value = answer.text;

library.name: Integration: Response Transform
library.code: const data = node.input.value; node.output.value = {ok: Boolean(data.ok), path: String(data.path || ''), received: Date.now()};

library.name: Integration: Store Result
library.code: const made = await agentsys('POST', 'collections/integration-results/records', {data: {result: node.input.value}}); node.output.value = made.data.result;
